title: Machine-Learning-Driven Synthesis of Carbon Dots with Enhanced Quantum Yields.
summary: Model-guided synthesis yielded carbon dots with experimentally measured enhanced quantum yield and ion-sensing performance. The abstract identifies regression but not its exact implementation.
